main_text.p: adeo dilectæ Photio, & ad quam promo-uendam operam suam locauerat, decreta, & statuta Photius seruauerit.

In Synodo Nicæna secunda ad illum diem antiquam Ecclesiæ consuetudinem retinentes Legati Pontificij præsident; in hac ab ea recedens, & ordinem rerum præuertens primum locum Photius occupat, secundum Pontificij concedit, & in omnibus Actionibus [illegible, ~7 letters] Photius: in ea semper Romani nomen præponitur, in hac Photij: in illa, vt mos erat, primi Legati Pontificij subscribunt, subsequitur Tarasius Patriarcha, in hac nulla subscriptio Photij est. Pudebat scilicet illum in similibus nævis, & patentibus Hagitijs sui nominis subscriptionem videri, homo pudentissimus, quod non veritus est Imperator, & illius filij. Septimæ Synodi Patres in literis Pontificijs contenta, absque vllo examine exosculantur; Photianæ illis impudentissime reluctantur, & apertissime aduersantur, clamantque, indebite illa sibi a Pontifice imponi: nunc ea se recipere, si suo vsui futura sunt, dictitant: nunc sibi propofita a Pontifice despicientes silentio prætereunt. page.notes: The Greek word in the Actionibus line is not legible enough to copy letter by letter; marked illegible. The printed text has "Photius" in the margin of the Greek line and a faint mark before "Photio" in the first line, which is not a printed letter. The catchword "de-" is the start of the next page's first word. Printed spellings such as "Hagitijs", "Photianæ" and "propofita" are kept as printed.
